title: Acceptance with a fixed number of choices
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register program, let an oracle and a Boolean input string $x$ be fixed, and let $a$ be an initial configuration. For a natural number $N$ and a Boolean value $b$, there is a choice string of length $N$ whose run from $a$ produces answer $b$.
